proposed_fixes.title: Parse packaged default-browser launch commands without Arc-specific hacks
proposed_fixes.root_cause: DefaultBrowserInfo may fail to extract a packaged Arc executable command when registration uses an unquoted WindowsApps path; this requires confirmation against the current registration.
plan: Inspect default-browser ProgId command parsing for packaged applications.
Parse executable and argument boundaries according to the registered command format rather than hard-coding browser names.
Add tests for quoted/unquoted packaged commands and URI-based launch targets.
verification: Confirm parsed target and arguments for Arc registration.
Run Web Search and verify a new tab opens with the requested search.

confidence.rationale: The parser has a product-specific Firefox workaround, but Arc registration and current behavior are unknown.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys Run 0.80.1 Web Search sometimes reports Failed to open Arc or foregrounds Arc without opening search results.
known_information: Report lists Arc 1.0.1.24682, Windows 11 22H2, default-browser setting and Web Search activation command.
Related Arc reports #31803/#33094/#33376 and proposed PR #34505 are linked.
Current DefaultBrowserInfo parses default-browser command and has a WindowsApps quoting workaround for Firefox only; parse failures fall back to Edge.
inferences: Arc packaged command line may be parsed as a filesystem path, but its registration format is not supplied.
issue_context.analysis: The current code makes browser-command parsing plausible, and PR #34505 was closed unmerged. Since the report is from 0.80.1, confirm current behavior and Arc install format before proposing general parser work; do not apply the issue comment registry workaround.
initial_investigation: `src/modules/launcher/Wox.Plugin/Common/DefaultBrowserInfo.cs` parses default-browser command and contains a Firefox-only WindowsApps quoting workaround.
Closed/unmerged PR #34505 and closed related reports do not establish a shipped fix.

comment.body: Thanks for listing the Arc build, Windows version, activation command and both failure outcomes. The earlier Arc PR #34505 was closed unmerged, and the current parser’s packaged-browser workaround is Firefox-specific. Could you confirm whether the failure still occurs on latest stable and whether Arc is installed as a packaged/MSIX app or standard desktop app? Please do not edit registry associations. This determines whether the command parser is still the relevant path.
